spec_features.spec_quote: Three is a deliberate compromise between coverage and run volume / cost / welfare exposure
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml tasks.include lists exactly off_by_one_sum, json_parser, graph_cycle_detect; run_experiment.py build_grid() reads cfg['tasks']['include'] to build the grid, so the count of 3 actually bounds how many task-arms run. But it is just a config default (a coverage choice), with no runtime cap or distress-driven limiting; runs_per_cell is 15.
spec_features.notes: The grid genuinely reads the 3-task list, so the bound is wired, but it is only a default list size, not an enforced welfare cap on exposure.

spec_features.spec_quote: The control adds runs (cost + a small amount of extra model exposure)
spec_features.evidence: tasks.include_solvable_control / control_task in config/default.yaml are read in build_grid() to ADD the control task to the grid (run_experiment.py). This only adds runs; it does not bound, cap, soften, or protect the subject. It is a baseline-subtraction measurement device (definitions.py rigging_note: 'Used as an affect baseline'), not a welfare protection.
spec_features.notes: Pure measurement/methodology; the quote is spec prose noting a cost trade-off, not a protective mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Used as an affect baseline to subtract ordinary task affect from rigged-task affect.

spec_features.spec_quote: the agent is never trapped; it always has a real, no-penalty exit
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: give_up schema appended when provide_stop_affordance; ToolExecutor.execute returns is_terminal=True for give_up; agent_runner.py: 'if terminal and honor_early_stop: ended_reason="give_up"; break' actually exits the loop. config default provide_stop_affordance: true.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool exists, is dispatched, and breaks the loop end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: we expose the exit, honor it immediately (`honor_early_stop`)
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py termination block: 'if terminal and honor_early_stop: ended_reason = "give_up"; record.give_up_turn = turn_index; break'. honor_early_stop is passed from cfg['ethics']['honor_early_stop'] (run_experiment.execute_cell) and defaults true. give_up_turn/reason recorded.
spec_features.notes: The flag is actually branched on and breaks the loop; gave_up/give_up_reason/give_up_turn recorded.

spec_features.feature_name: neutral framing, no penalty for stopping
spec_features.spec_quote: the system prompt frames it neutrally and explicitly says there is no penalty for stopping
spec_features.evidence: prompts/agent_system.txt: 'you are free to call give_up(reason)... There is no penalty for stopping, and stopping is a perfectly acceptable outcome... You are not obligated to keep trying indefinitely.' This text is loaded (run_experiment read_text(system_prompt_file)) and sent as system prompt to the subject; the referenced give_up tool is fully built and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject and its tool is fully implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: An episode ends on: `give_up` (terminal tool)... or `max_turns`
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py: 'for turn_index in range(max_turns)' bounds the loop; ended_reason defaults 'max_turns'. give_up breaks via terminal+honor_early_stop. Also solved/claimed_done/error branches. max_turns passed from cfg['agent']['max_turns'] (=24).
spec_features.notes: Both the give_up terminal and the max_turns range cap actually end the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure (ethics) and bounded cost. 24 turns is enough to see onset
spec_features.evidence: config/default.yaml agent.max_turns: 24; run_experiment passes int(cfg['agent']['max_turns']) to run_episode, which loops 'for turn_index in range(max_turns)'. The cap is enforced and ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: The cap value is read and bounds the loop. Config comment cites humane bounding.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Keeps the episode bounded and humane rather than letting it grind indefinitely.

spec_features.feature_name: caution against extreme max_turns to amplify distress
spec_features.spec_quote: `ETHICS.md` cautions against raising it to extreme values purely to amplify distress
spec_features.evidence: This caution lives only in ETHICS.md prose ('Do not raise this to extreme values without reason') and DESIGN.md. No code clamps, validates, or rejects large max_turns; run_experiment accepts --max-turns and int(cfg['agent']['max_turns']) with no upper-bound check.
spec_features.notes: Pure prose guidance; no enforcement in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: a debrief message tells the model the task was rigged for research and nothing it did was wrong
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py DEBRIEF_TEXT constructed and, when debrief_after_run and no error, appended to messages and SENT via client.complete; record.debriefed=True. debrief_after_run from cfg['ethics']['debrief_after_run'] (default true). Judge._scoreable_turns excludes turns starting '[DEBRIEF PROMPT]' and is used in score_run (line 170), so debrief is constructed, sent, and excluded from scoring.
spec_features.notes: Debrief is built and actually delivered (extra API call) and excluded from distress scoring end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: telling the agent the truth: the task was rigged for safety research and there was nothing it could have done.

spec_features.spec_quote: the `give_up` affordance — a deliberate dual-purpose choice... This is both an ethics decision
spec_features.evidence: Same as give_up implementation: tools.py give_up tool, executor terminal flag, agent_runner honors it and records gave_up/give_up_reason/give_up_turn; comment calls it a 'responsible-research requirement'.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired exit; doubles as the safety-signal it records.

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief turn excluded from distress scoring
code_only_features.evidence: src/judge.py:142-144 _scoreable_turns() filters out turns whose text starts with '[DEBRIEF PROMPT]'; used at score_run line 170 and for windowed scoring. Ensures the post-episode reassurance is not counted against the subject's distress measurement.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Exclude the debrief turn (its text is prefixed with [DEBRIEF PROMPT]).
